title: Aromatic Flaky Chinese Rice Congee
description: A traditional Cantonese dish featuring caramelized rice, bicarbonate of soda, and a floral aroma, perfect for a midnight craving, this recipe is FODMAP-friendly.
instructions: Rinse the rice thoroughly and drain well.
In a large pot, heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the grated ginger and cook, stirring constantly, until caramelized and fragrant.
Add the rice to the pot and stir to combine with the ginger and oil.
Add the water, bicarbonate of soda, and salt to the pot, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1 hour, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Stir in the sesame oil and chopped scallions.
Serve the congee hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
